correctness.rationale: For k<floor(n/2), degree 2k, so Dirac iff 4k≥n. For n<4k every nonadjacent cyclic distance k<d≤floor(n/2)<2k gives path u,u+k,u+d, with red k-edge and blue (d−k)-edge. At n=4k, every edge uniquely has clockwise span 1≤r≤k; color by start block parity floor(i/k) mod 2. Two geodesic steps starting at u and u+k have opposite block parity. Antipodes 0,2k have only common neighbors k,3k; both paths use two distance-k edges, so generator-based two-coloring cannot work. Diameter2 and noncompleteness force rc=src=2. Independently checked every nonadjacent pair for 5≤n≤50: 46,720 pairs, 11 boundary parameter families. Finite run confirms, not proves all n.
